case_name: Sussex County Planning & Zoning Commission v. Smokey Hollow, LLC

issues.label: Certiorari scope of review
issues.why: Court must determine what a common-law writ of certiorari permits it to examine versus a statutory appeal.

issues.label: Exhaustion of administrative remedies
issues.why: Smokey Hollow could appeal to County Council under §99-39(A) but sought reconsideration and certiorari instead.

issues.label: Availability of certiorari where appeal exists
issues.why: Certiorari is generally unavailable when an adequate remedy by appeal exists.

issues.label: Effect of no-appeal reconsideration provision
issues.why: Section 99-39(H) bars appeal from reconsideration decisions, affecting reviewability.

issues.label: Standard of review applied
issues.why: Court must apply substantial-evidence and legal-error review, not reweigh evidence de novo.

issues.label: Commission authority to impose conditions
issues.why: Whether the Commission may attach conditions to a code-compliant subdivision application.

issues.label: Definition of 'reasonable' condition
issues.why: Court must articulate the legal test for reasonableness of subdivision conditions.

issues.label: Conditions to minimize adverse impacts
issues.why: Whether conditions must be tied to minimizing impacts on neighbors versus other public-welfare goals.

issues.label: Neighborhood opposition as basis
issues.why: Whether reliance on public testimony/opposition is a permissible or impermissible ground for conditions.

issues.label: Elimination of a compliant lot
issues.why: Whether the Commission may eliminate lot 64 despite its code compliance.

issues.label: Substantial evidence for lot 64 findings
issues.why: Whether wetlands, flooding, and access findings are supported by adequate record evidence.

issues.label: Perimeter setback legislative determination
issues.why: Whether Condition A conflicts with Council's 30-foot perimeter setback standard.

issues.label: Setback versus buffer distinction
issues.why: Whether former §115-25F regulated wetland setbacks or buffers, defined differently in the code.

issues.label: Applicability of cluster development standards
issues.why: Whether cluster development buffer standards applied to Smokey Hollow's property.

issues.label: Retroactivity/pending-application exemption of Ord. 2852
issues.why: Whether Ordinance 2852's exemption for pending applications governs the buffer requirement.

issues.label: Which code version applies
issues.why: Whether the application is governed by the code at filing or later-adopted ordinances.

issues.label: Fixed versus average buffer requirement
issues.why: Whether a fixed 25-foot buffer exceeds what the code authorizes versus an average 30-foot buffer.

issues.label: Coastal Area environmental assessment relevance
issues.why: Whether §115-194.3's environmental assessment supports or constrains the conditions imposed.

issues.label: Duty to explain conditions
issues.why: Whether the Commission's failure to explain Condition O constitutes reversible legal error.

issues.label: Deference to agency code interpretation
issues.why: Whether the Commission's interpretation of its own ordinances warrants deference or de novo review.

issues.label: Delegated police-power scope
issues.why: Whether conditions fall within the police power delegated under 9 Del. C. §6902 and the Constitution.

issues.label: Remedy of striking versus remand
issues.why: Whether the proper disposition is to strike the conditions or remand for further findings.

issues.label: Severability of conditions from approval
issues.why: Whether invalid conditions can be excised without disturbing the overall subdivision approval.
